name: Sovereign Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts, and continues to the north and south. There is
desc3: a large spiked fence to the east, but it is so completely covered in
desc4: vines and plants that you cannot see through it. A gate breaks the
desc5: fence's monotony like an iron mouth, but it too is covered in dense
desc6: foliage. It is firmly locked. Off to the south you can see the street
desc7: ending in the broad face of the southern city wall.
